verdict.rationale: Parts of the product's surface are open. The Agentic Commerce Protocol, which Stripe co-developed, is stated to be "open source and community-designed under the Apache 2.0 license". The Link CLI's source is public at github.com/stripe/link-cli. MPP is published as an open spec with a public SDK. The core Agentic Commerce Suite is a hosted Stripe service, and nothing shows its source is readable. missing for 10: open-source code for the core ACS service (checkout routing, SPT handling, catalog ingestion), an explicit license for the Link CLI repository, independent confirmation of what the open repositories actually cover.
